mechanism: Cognitive Compression: Group related items into named chunks. Treat chunk as single unit in working memory. {{hierarchy}} of chunks enables handling complexity beyond raw capacity. Merge when patterns repeat; split when chunk becomes unwieldy. It applies {{aggregate}} to {{compress}} multiple working memory items into a single labeled unit.
failure_modes: Lossy Compression: Discarding critical low-level details (e.g., specific ID numbers) during the merge process.
invariants: The chunk's name states the criterion by which its items were grouped.
The merged chunk retains a retrieval hook for each part.

parameters.name: max_chunk_size
parameters.description: Largest merged chunk permitted, in the units the caller measures context by.
